title: Content Addressed Blob Store
description: Build the concrete content-addressed blob store backing MergeStrategyKind::ContentAddressedBlob / DocumentKind::ContentAddressedBlob (defined in framework/core/rs/lib.rs, consumed in vcs/rs/lib.rs merge logic). End to end: (1) vcs/rs/lib.rs BlobStore trait + BlobRef struct + FolderSqliteStorage sqlite-backed impl with a `blobs` table, dedupe-by-hash idempotent put, using framework/hash's Blake3 hash_bytes. (2) Hub storage trait (framework/product/os/hub/storage) put_blob/get_blob/has_blob methods + sqlite backend impl (routes are a separate ticket 0G, do not add HTTP routes). (3) WIT host functions write-blob/read-blob in framework/wit/world.wit + native host impl in framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs + web dev-server shim in framework/product/os/dev/script.ts (hostShimSource + dev middleware endpoint). (4) Browser IndexedDB blob cache with LRU eviction in framework/product/os/core/js/backbone-worker.ts, extending BackboneWorkerRequest/Response types in index.ts if needed. Add unit tests for put/get/dedupe/idempotence to vcs/rs/lib.rs existing test region. Run cargo check/test and bun typecheck to verify. This is part of a larger multi-agent media-graph program; sibling tickets 0C (also touches vcs/rs/lib.rs Studio region) and 0G (hub HTTP routes built on top of this trait) are concurrent/downstream — re-read files fresh before editing to avoid clobbering concurrent edits.
